safeguardsDescription: Second Moon can read protected paths but never change them. Before every turn that may change files, a checkpoint is saved that you can restore at any time.
protectedPlaceholder: Path in the project, e.g. data/raw
protectedEmpty: No protected paths yet. Adding the folder with your raw data is a good start.
checkpointSkippedHelp: Files over 20 MB and protected paths are neither saved nor restored.
restoreConfirm: Project files will go back to how they were at “{{label}}”, and files created since will be removed. Protected paths and large files are not affected. The current state is saved first, so this can be undone. Restore?
checkpointsUnavailable: Checkpoints need Git to be installed.
approval.privilege: Needs admin rights or runs a downloaded script
proposedTitle: Second Moon would like to remember
briefDescription: Every morning at 8, Second Moon reviews the last 24 hours: progress, what is still unverified and what needs your decision. It only reads and summarises; it runs no commands.
reportDescription: Written from recent research records, with every conclusion citing a record ID, and saved to the reports folder.
alert.turnFailed: This turn did not finish cleanly: {{subject}}
